searchText: EOF call #23 in ~1 hour https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/864 https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/85004720429?pwd=K1hnV1Z4bE1RZW50VEZTQnlCNHNuUT09 I summarized what I remember to be open questions: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/864#issuecomment-1727881911 will be joining the call but a couple minutes late Categories for changes to the spec I think are in 4 groups: (I) "Breaking"/incompatible changes (II) Feature parity (data, call) (III) Performance parity (gas/size) (IV) New features. Changes that would make previously valid EOF1 contracts invalid if they were shipped post-prague would be in category I. The container itself, behavior "x" fails validation, removing opcodes. Category II to IV could be brought in later forks but it is in a rough priority order of desired goals: II - do things we used to do III - do things we used to do without performance/size regression IV - do things we've never done before
